R&D notes

Tom & Jerry's rule: never ship what you have not restored. A backup that costs £0 to take and an afternoon to prove is still cheaper than the alternative.

The comparison is 5 < 6 < 7, and the quote is "measure it on the machine you will run it on" — which is the whole point of the drill.

Escaped markup should stay text: <script>alert(1)</script> is a string here, not a tag, and the reader should see it that way.
